name: Cyberion ThreatShield - Phase 4 baseline
description: 20 selected technique IDs assessed against DS001/DS002 using ATT&CK 19.2. All are Not Covered: no tested rules exist. Associated tactic labels are taxonomy, not observed adversary objectives. Unlisted techniques are outside this assessment. See coverage/assessment.md.

techniques.comment: Not Covered. DS001:275 records inline VBScript in mshta.exe; DS001:398 is its GUID-linked PowerShell child. Only this inline-VBScript variant is represented; no rule has passed replay or benign testing. Next: Implement CT-001 first and retain CT-C01 for correlation development.
